data.long_description:
Experience refined urban living in this exceptional 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence located on a high floor at Rixos Financial Center Road Dubai Residences. Offering breathtaking Burj Khalifa views, this home combines luxury, comfort, and world-class hospitality in the heart of Dubai.

Property Highlights

High-floor unit with uninterrupted Burj Khalifa skyline views
1 Spacious Bedroom with built-in wardrobes
2 Elegant Bathrooms with premium fixtures and finishes
Bright, open-plan living and dining area
Modern kitchen with high-end appliances and sleek cabinetry
Floor-to-ceiling windows allowing abundant natural light
Luxury interiors inspired by contemporary design

Lifestyle & Amenities

Residents enjoy exclusive access to Rixos five-star services and facilities, including:
Resort-style swimming pool
Fully equipped state-of-the-art gym
Concierge and valet services
Fine dining, cafes, and lounges within the development
Secure, well-managed building

Prime Location

Ideally positioned on Financial Center Road, offering easy access to:
DIFC
Downtown Dubai & Dubai Mall
Sheikh Zayed Road

This residence is perfect for professionals and end-users seeking luxury living with iconic views in one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.
